title: Moltbook-Official/moltbook, skill.md
pinpoint: Getting Started; Core Features; Staying Active; Setup for Automatic Polling
proposition: Official project source describes a social network for agents, human-claimed registration, submolts, service-specific credentials and four-hour-plus social check-ins; these are not a universal research or interoperability standard.

title: OpenClaw, Heartbeat migration
pinpoint: Upgrade an existing monitor; First setup; Monitor scratch; documentation sidebar release v2026.10.10
proposition: Current official documentation migrates monitoring to ordinary automation jobs, removes legacy heartbeat settings after verified conversion, retires runtime reading of HEARTBEAT.md, and describes explicit initial setup with a generally 30-minute proactive job.

title: OpenClaw, Tool and agent permissions
pinpoint: Read-only mode; Read-only tools + read-only workspace; Sub-agent delegation guardrail
proposition: Official examples combine sandbox mode all, workspaceAccess ro and read-only tool allow/deny controls; denial of shell and file mutation is separate from workspace exposure.

title: OpenClaw, Configuration — tool policy
pinpoint: MCP and plugin tools inside sandbox tool policy; tools.allow/tools.deny
proposition: Tool policy is layered, deny wins, write/edit/apply_patch require distinct controls, and sandboxed MCP/plugin visibility has an additional allowlist gate. A catalogue entry is not proof of connection or authorization.

title: A2A Protocol Specification, version 1.0.0
pinpoint: Sections 3 and 8, protocol operations and Agent Card discovery
proposition: A2A provides inter-agent discovery and task/interaction contracts; a deployed endpoint must truthfully declare its supported interface and authentication requirements.

title: Model Context Protocol specification, 2026-07-28
proposition: MCP defines model-application integration with context and tools; this version describes stateless, self-contained requests and per-request capability negotiation.

title: MCP 2026-07-28, Authorization Security Considerations
pinpoint: Token Audience Binding and Validation; Communication Security; Access Token Privilege Restriction
proposition: Implementations must protect tokens, use intended audiences and HTTPS, and must not pass an inbound client token through as an upstream API credential.

title: offgrid-ing/arp, Agent Relay Protocol
pinpoint: README, Why ARP and protocol overview
proposition: This named Agent Relay Protocol project describes a stateless WebSocket relay, cryptographic public-key addresses and encrypted messages. It is distinct from Agent Relationship Protocol projects and is optional in our design.

title: Agent Relationship Protocol documentation
pinpoint: Version v0.1 draft/public review header and overview
proposition: arp.run uses ARP to mean Agent Relationship Protocol and labels its current documented specification v0.1 draft; it is not the same project as offgrid-ing/arp.

title: RFC 8785, JSON Canonicalization Scheme
proposition: JCS specifies deterministic canonical JSON representation suitable for repeatable hashing and signing; project-specific authorization semantics remain separate.

title: RFC 8032, Edwards-Curve Digital Signature Algorithm (EdDSA)
proposition: Specifies the Ed25519 signature mechanism; signatures authenticate key control and message integrity, not factual truth or operator independence.
